draft.subject: Following up, and a quick ask about D3
draft.body:
Following up on the note I sent back in August, still hoping to actually get that catch up on the books this time.

I saw D3 has an opening for a Computer Vision and Deep Learning Engineer. Alongside the robotic arm work I mentioned before, I have also spent time optimizing custom CUDA kernels for faster inference and shrinking model footprints for edge deployment, which feels close to what your team might value given your embedded and DevOps background. If you could refer me for the role, point me to whoever runs that hiring process, or just share what the team is looking for, I would really appreciate it.

I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss the role further, if your time allows. I can share my resume if that would be helpful.
